question: ‘I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings’ is an autobiography of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maya Angelou.__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings:-**

 
 
• **It is a poignant and powerful autobiography by Maya Angelou, chronicling her childhood and early adolescence in the racially segregated South of the United States from the 1930s to the 1940s.**
 
• Through vivid storytelling and raw emotion, Angelou paints a vivid portrait of her experiences with racism, poverty, and trauma, yet also highlights her resilience, strength, and unwavering belief in the power of words and education.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dolly Alderton:-**

 
 
• She is a British writer and journalist born in 1994.
 
• She is best known for her novel Everything I Know About Love, which was adapted into a television series in 2022. Alderton has also written for publications such as The Guardian, The Sunday Times, and Vogue.
 
• She is known for her witty and insightful writing about love, relationships, and modern life.
 
 
 
• **Michelle Obama:-**
 
 
• She is an American lawyer, writer, and television personality who served as the First Lady of the United States from 2009 to 2017.
 
• She is the wife of former President Barack Obama. Obama is a graduate of Princeton University and Harvard Law School.
 
• She worked as a lawyer and corporate executive before entering public service. As First Lady, Obama focused on issues such as healthy living, education, and support for military families.
 
• She is also the author of two bestselling books, Becoming and The Light We Carry.
 
 
 
• **Patricia Lockwood:-**
 
 
• She is an American poet and essayist born in 1981.
 
• She is best known for her memoir Priestdaddy, which was a finalist for the 2017 National Book Critics Circle Award in Autobiography. Lockwood is also a contributing editor at The New Yorker.
